summary: Iteration 5 regression pass after config-only changes: (1) removed unused devDependency @emergentbase/visual-edits from frontend/package.json, (2) render.yaml updated with NODE_VERSION=20.11.1 and buildCommand relaxed from `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` to `yarn install`. Confirmed visual-edits is not imported anywhere under /app/frontend/src (grep clean). Ran full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/: 39 passed / 7 failed. All 7 failures are pre-existing environment mismatches in test_iter3_reviews_razorpay_cors.py (Razorpay is now live-configured with rzp_test_TF1GThmu5mJ6Ns keys in env — so tests asserting 'unconfigured' fail; CORS uses '*' wildcard — so tests asserting locked-down origin echo fail; cookies use SameSite=None+Partitioned — so tests asserting SameSite=lax fail). These are NOT caused by the package.json/render.yaml changes (those affect only frontend build, not backend runtime). Full backend_test.py (23/23) and test_iter4_guest_flow.py (8/8) both PASS. Frontend smoke test on preview URL: /, /products, /cart, /guest-checkout, /register all return HTTP 200 with correct UI rendered and only the expected 2x /api/auth/me 401 (guest visitor probe) — no new console errors. Key testids intact on /register (reg-name, reg-email, reg-password, reg-submit all FOUND) and /cart (cart-checkout-btn FOUND; cart-signin-link only renders with items in cart per iter4 design — expected MISSING on empty cart). App is healthy, config changes safe to deploy.

minor.issue: 3 tests assert Razorpay unconfigured (503 + empty key_id) but backend/.env now has RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=rzp_test_TF1GThmu5mJ6Ns configured. Tests are stale — should be updated to assert configured behavior OR gated behind an env flag. Pre-existing from iter3, not a regression.

3 tests assert CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoes the preview URL for allowed origins and is absent otherwise. Current backend responds with '*' wildcard. Either CORS was intentionally relaxed for the preview, or the lockdown regressed at some point. Pre-existing — not from this iteration.

Assertion expects SameSite=lax; login cookie is actually SameSite=None; Partitioned (cross-site cookie for embedded preview). Update the assertion to accept None+Partitioned, or make lax the standard. Pre-existing.

action_items: None blocking. Config change is safe — user can retry the Render Blueprint deploy.

Optional cleanup: update test_iter3_reviews_razorpay_cors.py to reflect current env state (Razorpay configured, CORS='*', SameSite=None) — these have been red for at least 2 iterations and give a noisy false signal on every regression run.
critical_code_review_comments: package.json change is clean — the removed @emergentbase/visual-edits was truly unused (grep -r visual-edits /app/frontend/src returned zero hits). Safe removal.

render.yaml relaxation from --frozen-lockfile to plain `yarn install` is pragmatic for unblocking Render builds when lockfile drifts slightly, but note it removes a determinism guardrail — future dependency updates on Render could pick up transitive versions that weren't tested locally. Fine for now given yarn.lock was regenerated, but consider re-adding --frozen-lockfile once the deploy stabilizes.
Pre-existing (called out in iter3/iter4 too): server.py is ~1370 lines and should be split into routers. Not caused by this iteration.
